name: domotz-mcp
description: Every Domotz endpoint, plus a local SQLite fleet mirror that answers cross-site questions.

domotz_api_key.title: Domotz API key
domotz_api_key.description: Your Domotz Public API key (Domotz Portal > Settings > API Keys: https://portal.domotz.com/portal/settings/services?selected_menu=api_keys). Sent only to the Domotz API host for your region as X-Api-Key.

domotz_region.title: DOMOTZ_REGION
domotz_region.description: Sets DOMOTZ_REGION for the endpoint template variable {region}.

domotz_base_url.title: Domotz API base URL
domotz_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from DOMOTZ_REGION. Set it only to point at a different host.

domotz_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
domotz_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

domotz_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
domotz_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

domotz_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
domotz_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Domotz requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

domotz_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
domotz_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
